# Nutanix

> Nutanix provides a unified hybrid multicloud platform for running applications, data, and AI workloads anywhere with enterprise-grade infrastructure management.

Nutanix is a leading enterprise cloud infrastructure company offering hyperconverged infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, and cloud management solutions. The site serves a global audience with localized content in multiple languages and regions.

## Key Topics

- Hybrid Multicloud
- Nutanix Cloud Platform
- Enterprise AI
- Kubernetes
- Infrastructure Modernization
- Cloud-Native
- Hyperconverged Infrastructure
- Unified Platform
- Distributed Infrastructure
- Software-Defined Platform
- Nutanix Central
- Cloud Infrastructure Management
- Enterprise Platform
- Infrastructure Management
- Kubernetes Containers

- [One Platform to Run Apps, Data, and AI Anywhere | Nutanix](https://www.nutanix.com): Nutanix unified platform for hybrid multicloud infrastructure and AI

- [Nutanix Cloud Platform Solution - Run Apps and Data Anywhere](https://www.nutanix.com/products/cloud-platform): Nutanix Cloud Platform for hybrid multicloud infrastructure management
- [Nutanix Central - Simplify Hybrid Multi-Cloud Management](https://www.nutanix.com/products/nutanixcentral): Nutanix Central unified console for hybrid multicloud management
